items.title: Marriott (MAR) Stock May Be 45% Overvalued On Fee Based Cash Flow
items.summary: Marriott International has ridden a powerful share price run in recent years, which puts fresh attention on what investors are actually paying for in terms of its cash flows. With the stock recently closing at US$425.90, the core issue is whether that market price still lines up with the cash the business can generate and return over time. Over the past 5 years, Marriott International has delivered a total shareholder return of 181.9%, which puts a lot of accumulated optimism on trial...

items.title: Marriott International (MAR) Looks Fully Valued Following Its Earnings Beat And Raised Outlook
items.summary: Marriott International (MAR) drew fresh attention after reporting third quarter earnings of $3.02 per share on $7.005 billion in revenue, topping analyst estimates and prompting an increase to its full year adjusted outlook. Marriott International’s latest beat on earnings lands after a strong run, with a 30-day share price return of 9.01% and a 90-day gain of 19.43%. Its 1-year total shareholder return of 51.11% signals momentum that has been building rather than fading. Scan beyond Marriott...
